title: Indian Express Newspapers (Bombay) Pvt. Ltd. v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Indian Express Newspapers (Bombay) Pvt. Ltd. v. Union of India, (1985) 1 SCC 641
content.facts: The validity of delegated legislation imposing customs duty on newsprint was challenged.
questionsBeforeCourt: What are the grounds for judicial review of subordinate legislation?
Does subordinate legislation enjoy the same immunity as plenary legislation?
What is the legal character and source of subordinate legislation?
content.ratioDecidendi: Delegated legislation is open to judicial review on constitutional and statutory grounds, including lack of legislative competence and violation of the Constitution or enabling Act.
content.holding: The Court articulated the judicial-review framework for subordinate legislation.
content.relevance: Use as a leading authority on control of delegated legislation.
